description: This file defines a Dart class 'TokenStore' for handling secure storage and retrieval of authentication tokens and session IDs using the SharedPreferences package.

classes.name: TokenStore
classes.description: A class providing methods to store and retrieve access tokens, refresh tokens, and session IDs asynchronously using shared preferences.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored access token, returning null if none is stored or if the stored value is empty.

methods.name: setAccessToken
methods.description: Stores or removes the access token based on whether the provided token is null or empty.

methods.name: getRefreshToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored refresh token, returning null if none is stored or if the stored value is empty.

methods.name: setRefreshToken
methods.description: Stores or removes the refresh token based on whether the provided token is null or empty.

methods.name: getSessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the stored WebSocket session ID, or null if none is stored or empty.

methods.name: setSessionId
methods.description: Stores or removes the session ID based on whether the provided sessionId is null or empty.
